system.description:
Lamp oil? Rope? Bombs? You want it? It’s yours my friend, as long as you have enough rubies.

—Morshu, Link: The Faces of Evil

May they be an appraiser of rare magic items, peddler of illicit substances, or bookkeeper for the court, merchants are masters of exchange.

Iconic Merchants

  • Anna, Fire Emblem
  • Marco Polo, Venetian merchant
  • Torneko Taloon, Dragon Quest IV
  • Tressa Colzione, Octopath Traveler

Playing Merchant

The merchant is a low-defense and damage character, who provides high-support through a wider inventory pool and optimizing your party’s resources. In combat, you should look out for allies in need of assistance and strategize what items to use.

Action: Use
Move: Flexible (skip to Use)
Starting Pack: Blacksmith, Cook, or Tinker
Key Stat: Luck/Reason
Complexity: ★★★☆☆
Training: Craft, Finesse, Influence

levelFeatures.name: Gold Sink
levelFeatures.description: You can take the Use Action to place Item(s) that aren’t Fabled Relics inside a container and choose one Item with a value no higher than the Item(s) placed inside. The chosen Item replaces the originals. If the value exceeds 1g, you must spend 1 Luck to do so.

levelFeatures.name: Deep Pockets
levelFeatures.description: You gain the Deft Hands Perk (p. 68), and you gain 2 extra Item Slots now and every 3 Levels hereafter.

levelFeatures.name: Line Goes Up (+1 Luck)
levelFeatures.description:
You gain 1 Luck during a Breather and when you spend a Shift to Craft or Travel.

Further, when you Rest, you gain 1 extra Luck. This extra Luck gained from a Rest increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

levelFeatures.name: Perk
levelFeatures.description: Choose a new Perk. You must meet the prerequisites to take it, unless the Perk is granted through a Class Feature.

levelFeatures.name: Diamond Hands (+1)
levelFeatures.description: You can take the Use Action to change the Power of a Relic you are holding to another Power of equal or lesser value. The Powers must be valued at 250g or lower. This value is multiplied by 5 every 4 Levels hereafter.
